page.overview:
Who is Tighe Skorda?

Captain Tighe Skorda was a soldier of House Atreides.

Tighe Skorda was found by the Prisoner in Hagga Basin. Near death, he declared that he would tell them anything they wished to know. They asked him what the bad spice was and he replied that he did not know, as they had found it on Ix and did not know how dangerous it was until the Kytheria crashlanded on Arrakis. The crew then began dying and he abandoned them to recover one of the containers, which he sold to the Sandflies. He was then pursued by mercenaries and evaded them. He then joined the Maas Kharet and went into hiding. Once he got sick, Nahla and Jorba turned on him and he fled. He told the Prisoner that it did not matter which of the Great Houses won the War of Assassins, as everyone else would suffer. The Prisoner then left him to die.
